notes.title: New version build & bug fixed
notes.notes:
Okay so I notice that the previous version messed up with the achievement system.

I remember I was using a different renpy version when building the other version, so that could cause the issue.
I uploaded a new version that possibly will fix this.

Let me know if the problem still persist!
Verry sorry for the inconvenience!

notes.title: Logic gates image fixed
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, I notice some of you found that there's a mistake regarding the drawing of the logic gates guide.

I fix this issue. Other than that, the solution of some logic gate puzzle is correct & the same.
Hopefully this will be the last bug fixes.

Thank you everyone & enjoy the game!
